issues.issue: Whether the 2011 Newroz detention, torture and political profile are credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says police beat and detained him at the 2011 Newroz celebration and he has a political profile.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel questioned lack of documents proving the detention or presence in Turkey in 2011.
issues.result_text: Detention, torture and political profile not established; events as relayed by claimant not believed.

issues.issue: Whether departure from Turkey and passport evidence show Turkish interest
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the agent arranged his passport and exit, and he showed ID at Istanbul airport.
issues.result_text: No difficulties with Turkish authorities at departure; airport evidence inconsistent and evasive.

issues.issue: Whether the Venezuela trip, student status and military-deferral documents are credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he was a student with a military exemption and that the agent took his ID.
issues.result_text: Student status, exemption and Venezuela trip unsupported; documents given little weight; credibility impugned.

issues.issue: Whether delay and failure to claim protection in transit countries undermine subjective fear
issues.result_text: Delay and failure to claim in the US inconsistent with subjective fear, despite brothers' refugee claims.

issues.issue: Whether conscription and conscientious objection create a risk of persecution
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he fears detention and persecution for evading military service as a conscientious objector.
issues.result_text: No sufficient evidence that prosecution for military non-compliance amounts to persecution.

issues.issue: Whether return would expose the claimant to torture or cruel treatment (s.97)
issues.result_text: No substantial grounds to believe torture or cruel treatment on return to Turkey.
